name: Approvals
description: Sign-offs that gate states of the type's Workflow. A transition into a gated state, from a state its gate allows, waits until as many distinct principals holding the gate's permission as its count have signed off; the instance's creator cannot sign unless the gate allows it. A change of the instance's own fields consumes every gate's sign-offs, unless the config keeps them, and entering a gated state consumes that gate's, so a return to it signs again. Consumed sign-offs stay listed. Deleting the instance deletes its sign-offs.

count.description: How many distinct principals must sign off before a transition into the state.

excludeCreator.description: Whether the principal who created the instance is refused a sign-off; true when absent.

from.description: The states of the type's Workflow a transition from is gated; every state when absent.

permission.description: The permission a caller needs to sign off.

pinned.description: Whether a sign-off names the row's version its signer read: signOff then needs version, and one that is not the row's version is vetoed stale. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

resetOn.description: The own fields whose change, by an update, consumes the gate's sign-offs; [] for none. Absent, the gate follows resetOnChange. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

gates.description: The gates, by the state of the type's Workflow each gates.

resetOnChange.description: Whether a change of the instance's own fields, an update or an operation's, consumes every gate's sign-offs; true when absent.

status.description: The field of the type whose Workflow the gates are of. Implied when the type has one Workflow; needed when it has several. A Workflow anchored on the type is named Workflow. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

fields.name: gates
fields.description: The sign-offs not yet consumed, by gated state: { <state>: { signedBy } }, each subject that signed, in the order they signed; a gate with none is absent.

tables.name: signOffs
tables.description: One row per sign-off on the row, keyed by its number, the order it was given in: the gated state, the subject who signed, why, when, and when it was consumed, absent while it counts. A withdrawal deletes its row; consumed ones stay for listSignOffs.

fields.name: number
fields.description: The sign-off's number on the row, from 1 in the order they were given, in ten digits zero-padded so the key's order is theirs.

fields.name: state
fields.description: The gated state it signs off for.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: The subject of the caller who signed.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When it was given, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: consumedAt
fields.description: When a change of the fields its gate names, an entry into the gated state or a build without its gate consumed it; absent while it counts.

operations.name: signOff
operations.description: Signs off on the instance for a gated state, as the caller. Needs the gate's permission; refused for the instance's creator unless the gate allows it, while the instance is in the state, and for a caller whose sign-off for the state is not yet consumed.

state.description: The gated state to sign off for.

version.description: The row's version the signer read, the version a write through the core is held to. Needed on a pinned gate; on any gate, one that is not the row's version is vetoed stale before anything else is checked. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

resultSchema.description: The sign-off, with the gate's sign-offs after it and the count it needs.

signedBy.description: Every subject whose sign-off for the state is not yet consumed, in the order they signed.

subject.description: The subject of the caller who signed.

operations.name: withdrawSignOff
operations.description: Withdraws the caller's sign-off for a gated state, one not yet consumed.

state.description: The gated state whose sign-off to withdraw.

at.description: When it was signed, in epoch milliseconds.

subject.description: The subject of the caller who signed.

operations.name: listSignOffs
operations.description: Lists the instance's sign-offs, oldest first, one page at a time, the consumed ones included; with state, only those for it.

cursor.description: The next of the previous page.

limit.description: At most this many sign-offs; 50 when absent.

consumedAt.description: When a change of the own fields, entering the state or a new version without its gate consumed it; absent while it counts.

subject.description: The subject of the caller who signed.

next.description: The cursor of the next page; null after the last.

vetoes.description: A transition into a gated state, from a state its gate allows, with fewer sign-offs than its count; details give the state, the count required and the sign-offs it has.
signOff by a caller whose sign-off for the state is not yet consumed.
signOff by the principal who created the instance, on a gate that excludes the creator.
signOff while the instance is in the gated state.
signOff or withdrawSignOff for a state the config does not gate.
withdrawSignOff by a caller with no sign-off for the state that is not yet consumed.
signOff naming a version that is not the row's version: what the signer read has moved since; details give the version it named and the row's. A table's alone: an engine type refuses version.
